name: Corpus-led Academy organ audit
method: distinguish a continuous Academy obligation from a formation product, engagement role, or procured specialty
give a continuous obligation one accountable Academy office
do not create an Academy office merely because a customer office needs that specialty in its formation bundle

obligations.obligation: keep a sovereign service membrane, admit or refuse contracts, procure missing specialties, and answer for Academy resources
obligations.rule: one office owns the Academy boundary; it does not absorb foreign service work

obligations.obligation: keep reproducible formation epochs, candidate lineages, qualifications, and requalification deltas without an imperial latest-version line
obligations.rule: configuration custody, registration, and qualification lineage are one continuous record obligation

obligations.obligation: compile complete, authority-preserving office formation bundles from actual office, character, persona, skill, context, learning, and harness carriers
obligations.rule: this office owns compilation; the foreign offices and provider runtimes remain foreign

obligations.obligation: conduct situated progressive practice and coordinate current-practitioner teaching and named mentorship
obligations.rule: lecturer and mentor are accountable engagement castings; they are not automatically permanent Academy offices

obligations.obligation: judge answerable performance independently and return evidence or refusal without appointment authority
obligations.rule: examination stays independent of formation and qualification remains distinct from recognition, induction, installation, and capability grants
